rules.statement: A receipt must bear a 5-cent stamp, under the Ordinance No. 3 of 1890, and therefore endorsements on the document without proper stamps are inadmissible to prove payment of interest so as to avoid prescription.
rules.supporting_quote: A receipt must bear a 5-cent stamp, under the Ordinance No. 3 of 1890. Sampayo, for plaintiff, respondent.-The defendant does not dispute the payments, appearing on the back of the document. He does not object to them in his petition of appeal.
